verdict.rationale: Clerky documents a Partner API with endpoints such as POST /v1/document_sets, plus an llms.txt index and a remote MCP server. None of the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec for that API. Per-form `json_schema` payloads and llms.txt are adjacent features, not an API spec, and the OpenAPI probe found 404s on every candidate path (though it only checked the handbooks domain, not developers.clerky.com).
